description: This file implements a network management plugin with JSON-RPC methods, event subscriptions, and internal logic for handling network interfaces, IP settings, and internet connectivity status within the WPEFramework environment.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A dispatchable job class that executes a provided function.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the network plugin, sets environment, and subscribes to network events.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops timers, and unregisters methods.

methods.name: registerLegacyMethods
methods.description: Registers JSON-RPC methods for network operations.

methods.name: unregisterLegacyMethods
methods.description: Unregisters JSON-RPC methods.

methods.name: getInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves available network interfaces.

methods.name: setStunEndpoint
methods.description: Sets the STUN server endpoint for NAT traversal.

methods.name: setInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the current default network interface.

methods.name: setDefaultInterface
methods.description: Sets the default network interface (stub implementation).

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for a network interface.

methods.name: internalGetIPSettings
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve IP settings.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves IP settings for a specified interface.

methods.name: getIPSettings2
methods.description: Retrieves IP settings with different response format.

methods.name: isConnectedToInternet
methods.description: Checks if the specified IP version is connected to the internet.

methods.name: getInternetConnectionState
methods.description: Gets the current internet connection state.

methods.name: doPing
methods.description: Performs a ping to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: doTrace
methods.description: Performs a trace route to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: getPublicIP
methods.description: Retrieves the public IP address.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is enabled.

methods.name: setConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Sets endpoints for connectivity testing.

methods.name: startConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Starts connectivity monitoring (stub).

methods.name: getCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Retrieves the URI for captive portal detection.

methods.name: stopConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Stops connectivity monitoring (stub).

methods.name: getStbIp
methods.description: Gets the IP address of the set-top box.

methods.name: getSTBIPFamily
methods.description: Gets the IP family (IPv4/IPv6) of the set-top box.
